about.subtitle: Bridging Two Worlds
about.description: Good Film AI (Summer Grace LLC) is a film and video production studio based in Silicon Valley, with a production team rooted in LA/Hollywood craftsmanship. We bring together cutting-edge technology and cinematic artistry to serve the world's most innovative companies.
about.description2: We specialize in corporate storytelling, event documentation, and commercial production for tech companies, conferences, and nonprofit organizations. As pioneers in AI Film, we're exploring how generative AI and AI agents can revolutionize the filmmaking process.

aifilm.title: AI Film
aifilm.subtitle: The Future of Filmmaking
aifilm.description: We're at the forefront of AI-powered filmmaking, exploring how generative AI and intelligent agents can transform every stage of production — from pre-visualization and scriptwriting to post-production and visual effects.
aifilm.feature1_desc: Using state-of-the-art generative AI to create stunning visuals, expand creative possibilities, and accelerate production workflows.
aifilm.feature2_desc: Deploying intelligent AI agents that assist with scheduling, asset management, and creative decision-making throughout the production pipeline.
aifilm.feature3_desc: Our AI-assisted films have been showcased at AI Film Festivals, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in cinematic storytelling.
